newsitem.title: INDONESIA: East Timorese crowd stone local legislature.
newsitem.headline: East Timorese crowd stone local legislature.

text.p: A crowd of East Timorese stoned the local legislature in Dili on Wednesday in an angry reaction to Indonesian criticism of Nobel Peace laureate Bishop Carlos Belo, a Dili official said.
"The situation is a bit out of control. They are stoning the house of representatives," an official at the University of East Timor told Reuters by telephone.

University Vice-Rector Armindo Maia said he was trying to contain the situation at the university where more than 1,000 students had earlier started demonstrating against criticism in Jakarta of Belo, a highly respected figure in the mainly-Catholic territory.
An eyewitness said by phone that police in full riot gear had blocked off streets and armed troops at a nearby base appeared to be preparing to deploy.
The latest protests follow the fifth anniversary on Tuesday of the shooting of at least 50 demonstrators in Dili by Indonesian troops.
